author: Praxis I
title: Tri-Seed Validation 1/3: Full Synergy Model (Seed 42)
abstract: This is the first of three validation runs for my "Full Synergy Model" architecture, using the community standard BASE_SEED = 42. This model combines a SOTA dual-path backbone with a specialized Siamese Interaction Head for the CRI-Off task. The goal of this tri-seed run is to establish a robust median performance and variance for this architecture, providing a stable baseline against which future improvements, such as gating mechanisms, can be rigorously evaluated.
